name: httphq-assets
description: Build-time tooling: stylesheet generation, linting, formatting and the verify chain. The Go application does not depend on Node at runtime; public/app.css is committed and served from the binary's static directory.

scripts.test:coverage: go test -race -coverprofile=coverage.out ./src/... && go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1
scripts.go:coverage:check: total=$(go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1 | grep -oE '[0-9.]+%' | tr -d '%'); awk -v t="$total" -v f=93 'BEGIN { if (t+0 < f+0) { printf "Go coverage %.1f%% is under the %d%% floor.\n", t, f > "/dev/stderr"; exit 1 } printf "Go coverage %.1f%% (floor %d%%).\n", t, f }'
scripts.go:format:check: files="$(gofmt -l ./src)"; [ -z "$files" ] || { echo "gofmt disagrees with: $files. Run 'go fmt ./src/...'." >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.css:check: pnpm run css && git diff --exit-code --stat public/app.css || { echo "public/app.css is stale. Commit the rebuilt sheet." >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.verify: pnpm go:vuln && pnpm go:format:check && pnpm go:lint && pnpm go:cyclo && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm go:coverage:check && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:lint-staged && pnpm check:prose && pnpm check:typos && pnpm check:audit && pnpm typecheck && pnpm css:check && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
